title: PowerA MOGA XP5-A Plus Bluetooth Controller, New

comparisons.notes: Walmart item 891892226, UPC 617885019685, model XP5-A Plus, condition New, in stock (marketplace seller ABC-Dealz).

writeup: Woot has the PowerA MOGA XP5-A Plus Bluetooth controller new for $14.99, limit 3 per order. It is a mobile controller for Android, PC and cloud gaming with a built-in 3000mAh power bank that charges your phone while you play and a detachable phone clip. Walmart lists the same UPC 617885019685 model at $65, so this is about 76% less.
amazon_match_notes: Exact ASIN B081C1DMZG from the Woot offer; UPC 617885019685 and MPN 1509756-01 match the PowerA MOGA XP5-A Plus.
